## Load data


```{r load_data}

dataset <- readxl::read_excel("Credit_Risk_Dataset_Onyx_Data_September_25.xlsx")
```


## Encoded Data

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(caret)

# Save original client_IDs

client_IDs <- dataset$client_ID

# Select relevant columns

selected_variables <- c(
  "loan_status", "person_age", "person_income", "person_home_ownership",
  "person_emp_length", "loan_intent",  "loan_amnt", "loan_to_income_ratio"
)

# excluding "loan_grade" because it is not independent

dataset <- dataset |> select(all_of(selected_variables))

# Replace outliers

dataset <- dataset |>
  mutate(
    person_age = ifelse(person_age > 100,
      median(person_age, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_age
    ),
    person_emp_length = ifelse(person_emp_length > 70,
      median(person_emp_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_emp_length
    )
  )

# Impute missing

dataset <- dataset |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .)))

# Convert to factors

dataset <- dataset |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Encode factors
encoded_dataset <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = dataset |>
  select(where(is.factor))) |> as.data.frame()

dataset <- cbind(dataset, encoded_dataset)


dataset <- dataset |> select(-where(is.factor))

# Correct column names

colnames(dataset) <- make.names(colnames(dataset))


# Split into train and test

set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(dataset$loan_status, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

dataset[train_index, "is_train"] <- 1
dataset[-train_index, "is_train"] <- 0

# Add back client_IDs
dataset <- cbind(client_ID = client_IDs, dataset)

output <- dataset

glimpse(output)
```

```{r save-encoded}

readr::write_csv(output, "encoded_dataset.csv")

```


## Marginal Effects from GLM

```{r glm-model}
library(dplyr)
library(caret)

train <- dataset |> select(-c(client_ID, is_train))

# standardize numeric variables

continuous_variables <- c(
  "person_age", "person_income", "person_emp_length", "loan_amnt",
  "loan_to_income_ratio"
)
factor_columns <- c(
  "person_home_ownership", "loan_intent"
)

# First, train without standardizing

glm_model <- glm(loan_status ~ 0 + .,
  family = "binomial", data = train
)

p_hat <- predict(glm_model, type = "response")

# Extract coefficients
betas <- coef(glm_model)

# Compute marginal effects: β_j * p * (1-p)
AME <- sapply(1:length(betas), function(j) {
  mean(betas[j] * p_hat * (1 - p_hat), na.rm = TRUE)
})

names(AME) <- names(betas)
raw_effects <- data.frame(effect_raw = AME, coef = betas) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Variable")

train <- train |> mutate(across(
  .cols = c(continuous_variables),
  .fns = ~ (. - mean(., na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(., na.rm = TRUE)
))

glm_model <- glm(loan_status ~ 0 + .,
  family = "binomial", data = train
)

p_hat <- predict(glm_model, type = "response")

# Extract coefficients
betas <- coef(glm_model)

# Compute marginal effects: β_j * p * (1-p)
AME <- sapply(1:length(betas), function(j) {
  mean(betas[j] * p_hat * (1 - p_hat), na.rm = TRUE)
})

names(AME) <- names(betas)

output <- data.frame(effect_std = AME) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Variable")

output <- output |> left_join(raw_effects, by = "Variable")

reg_templ <- paste(factor_columns, collapse = "|")

output <- output |> mutate(Factor = gsub(reg_templ, "", Variable))
output <- output |> mutate(Factor = stringr::str_replace(Factor, Variable, ""))

output <- output |> 
  mutate(Variable = gsub(paste0("(", reg_templ, ").+"), "\\1", Variable))

# Calculate relative effects in groups

output <- output |>
  mutate(group = ifelse(Variable %in% continuous_variables, "continuous", Variable))

output <- output |>
  group_by(group) |>
  mutate(
    factor_mean = mean(effect_std),
    effect_factor_z_score = ((effect_std - factor_mean) / sd(effect_std))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-c(factor_mean, group))

output <- output |>
  mutate(effect_z_score = ((effect_std - mean(effect_std)) / sd(effect_std)))

output
```

```{r}

summary(glm_model)
```

## Cross-Validation for GLM

```{r load-dataset}

dataset <- read.csv("encoded_dataset.csv")
```

```{r glm-cross-validation}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(caret)

dataset <- dataset |>
  mutate(
    loan_status = as.factor(loan_status)
  )

train <- dataset |>
  filter(is_train == 1) |>
  select(-c(client_ID, is_train))

test <- dataset |>
  filter(is_train == 0) |>
  select(-c(client_ID, is_train))
glm_model <- glm(loan_status ~ 0 + .,
  family = "binomial", data = train
)

glm_probs <- predict(glm_model, newdata = test, type = "response")

glm_pred <- ifelse(glm_probs > 0.5, 1, 0) |> as.factor()

# Confusion matrix
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(glm_pred, test$loan_status)

output <- data.frame(Value = conf_matrix$byClass) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Parameter") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = Value)

output
```

```{r glm-roc-curve}

library(pROC)
library(PRROC)

# ROC curve
roc_glm <- roc(response = test$loan_status, predictor = glm_probs)

plot(roc_glm, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve - Logistic Regression")

auc(roc_glm)

```
